title: Beyond the Syntax: Why Reading is the Ultimate Superpower in the Age of AI
summary: We live in an era where writing code has never been easier. With AI assistants generating boilerplate, functions, and modules in seconds, the engineering bottleneck has shifted. It is no longer about how fast you type, but how deeply you comprehend system architecture, RFCs, and edge cases. In the age of AI, reading is the ultimate engineering superpower.

title: The Recon Job That Changed the System: A Lesson in High-Volume Financial Consistency
summary: A reconciliation job for one segment sounded harmless. Then we had five. How conducting deep root-cause analysis (RCA) on ledger data discrepancies transformed our approach to batch processing, repository-level invariants, and asynchronous consistency across multi-party financial reconciliation workflows.

title: ProbSol Materialised: An Engineering Thought Vault to Declutter Builder Minds
summary: How many times have you had a breakthrough idea or encountered a complex bug... only to forget it 2 hours later? As builders, our heads are constantly buzzing with scattered notes across tabs, mixing up active bugs, ideas, and solutions. That's why I built ProbSol Materialised — a dedicated thought vault designed to declutter your mind and segregate thought patterns.

title: Can a Software Engineer Bleed Code?
summary: What if the best software engineers don't just write code... they bleed it? Inspired by EPR's 'bleed ink' on Hustle, reflecting on reaching a plane where engineering isn't just about 'knowing Java' or 'having 4 years of experience', but reaching an instinctive level where concurrency hazards, architectural trade-offs, and craftsmanship flow naturally.
